title: Quantization and Integrations
summary: This module provides tools for optimizing model performance and integrating with external systems. It includes various quantization techniques to reduce model size and accelerate inference, as well as utilities for connecting with external libraries and services for experiment tracking, hyperparameter tuning, and efficient model serving via CLI.

nodes.label: Model Quantization
nodes.title: Model Quantization Techniques
nodes.description: Provides various techniques (e.g., 4-bit, 8-bit, FP8) to reduce model size and accelerate inference, supporting both pre-quantized models and on-the-fly quantization.

nodes.label: External Integrations
nodes.title: External Tools Integration
nodes.description: Connects Hugging Face models and workflows with external platforms for experiment tracking (Wandb, DVCLive), hyperparameter search, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT).

nodes.label: CLI Serving Tools
nodes.title: Command-Line Serving Tools
nodes.description: Offers command-line interfaces for serving Transformer models via an API, including features like continuous batching, dynamic model management, and integration with quantization.

nodes.label: Model Architectures
nodes.title: Core Model Definitions
nodes.description: The foundational module containing definitions of various deep learning models that are optimized and served by this module.

nodes.label: Pipelines & Generation
nodes.title: Generation Logic & Task Pipelines
nodes.description: Provides core text generation algorithms and high-level task-specific pipelines, which can be integrated with external tools or served via CLI.

groups.label: Core Sub-Modules
groups.title: Internal Sub-Modules
groups.description: The primary components within the `quantization_and_integrations` module, focusing on model optimization, external tool connectivity, and serving.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: Dependent Modules
groups.description: Other key modules within the Transformers library that interact with and are leveraged by the components in this module.
